OROMLANG 1: Focus is on speaking, writing, reading, and listening abilities in Oromo. Interactive approach enables students to express concepts and develop communicative competence at the basic level. Cultural context is an essential part of the course. This is the first part of a three-part series.
OROMLANG 2: Focus is on speaking, writing, reading, and listening abilities in Oromo. Interactive approach enables students to express concepts and develop communicative competence at the basic level. Cultural context is an essential part of the course. This is the second course of a three-part series.
OROMLANG 3: Focus is on speaking, writing, reading, and listening abilities in Oromo. Interactive approach enables students to express concepts and develop communicative competence at the basic level. Cultural context is an essential part of the course. This is the third course of a three-part series. Completion of this course completes the language requirement.
OROMLANG 395: Prerequisite: For Grad Students Only and Consent of Instructor
